_comment: Net deposits = base + the sum of every ledger entry. Vanguard exposes only about three months of transactions through Plaid, so 'base' is a one-time anchor for the history Plaid cannot see, and 'base_through' is the date that anchor is complete through. Deposits dated on or before base_through are already inside base and are never added again; everything after is appended automatically, keyed by Plaid's transaction id so a deposit ageing out of Plaid's window can be neither dropped nor double-counted. 'ignored_ids' holds Plaid transaction IDs the user confirmed are bogus or mislabeled; the fetch script skips these transactions and they must never be auto-added to the ledger. 'confirmed_cash' is a user-confirmed cash balance that Plaid's holdings feed misreports; fetch.js stands it in when Plaid's VMFXX figure disagrees, so the headline total stays truthful. You should not need to edit this file.

confirmed_cash.note: User-confirmed settled deposit 2026-10-08; Plaid holdings omitted VMFXX
